What it solves: - Minted 2026-09-08 by the specifier the same pass the red was reported,
  per the standing-red rule (Article 3.2.4, 2026-09-05 amendment):
  type defect, severity high, register row added in the mint commit with
  first_seen 2026-08-25, matching BL-1480's sibling rows which date from
  when the r…
